Game Overview

In Pigeon Bomber, the core idea is straightforward: soar through the skies as Jack, the Pigeon Bomber, spreading chaos from above. Navigate the bustling city skyline and unleash your feathery fury to relieve your avian angst, aiming at unsuspecting pedestrians and objects below for endless hilarity.
